initial_check_failure: The first draft incorrectly equated nonzero CT pixels with rendered_px. It stopped before panel checks; corrected using bbox area, while preserving the zero-valued CT pixels.

visual_review.coverage: Six figures at five spatial tiles, including portions of all seven models in both directions. Numerical coverage is broader than visual coverage.
observations: Hecate reverse whole image has scattered isolated bright blobs without a selected regular letter line.
Reader and dense views have broad diffuse areas; these selected native views do not resolve distinctive letter strokes.
Seed42/43 have broad connected bright shapes and boundary response; CT itself shows pronounced diagonal fibres, cracks and layer breaks.
Different predictions share some bright areas, but agreement alone does not identify ink or a legible glyph.
visual_review.decision: No ROI selected for additional CT on the evidence inspected. This is not proof of absent ink or a negative conclusion for the whole scroll.

limitations: Physical sheet identity and exact XYZ mapping were not verified.
Nominal 9.6 um canvas spacing is not a verified exact physical calibration.
Published maps are prior work; this screening is not our letter discovery.
